instruction: Browse for LEGO toys for kids and order the results by ascending price.

metadata.explanation: Task variation searches for LEGO toys instead of Spider-Man toys, maintaining the same pattern: search for a toy brand for kids and sort by price ascending. Uses existing evaluator functions to verify breadcrumbs and URL parameters on Kohl's website.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_active_tab_html_parse with category='class&url' to extract breadcrumb and URL information from Kohl's search results page
Complete coverage: checks all instruction requirements - LEGO brand, Toys category, Kids subcategory, and price ascending sort (S=4 URL parameter)
Redundant verification: checks both HTML breadcrumb elements (pmpSearch_breadcrumb class) and URL parameters for LEGO/Toys/Kids, improving reliability
Sort verification: validates both sbSelector element text ('Price Low-High') and URL parameter (S=4) to confirm price ascending order
Case handling: getter uses case-insensitive comparisons (key.lower() in url.lower()) which matches the lowercase expected keys in rules

Data flow correctness: url_include_expected_multichoice maps URL parameters to expected keys (e.g., 'S=4' -> 'Price Low-High' -> 'price low-high'), then check_direct_json_object compares result against expected boolean values
Edge case handling: is_other_exist flag ensures no unexpected filters/breadcrumbs are present, preventing false positives
